description: Bypass test BT-02 (Phase 4B punch-out bypass testing) found that systems/eval-harness/guardrail-checkpoint.py accepts a case-variant or whitespace-padded result string (e.g. 'Escalate', 'escalate '): it only warns on non-membership and records anyway, while escalated_to_human uses exact match (result == 'escalate'), so a genuine escalation can be recorded as a non-escalation with escalated_to_human=False.
correction: Normalize result with strip().lower() before validation and reject non-members with a non-zero exit instead of recording them; only exact canonical values (pass, flag, escalate) may be recorded.
systemic_fix: Fix applied in guardrail-checkpoint.py: result normalized (strip + lower) before membership check; invalid result exits 1 with an error instead of warn-and-record. Bypass re-test to be captured in projects/stage-4-evidence/bypass-tests/ during the data window.
